name: hero-motion
js: const h = document.querySelector('#top'); const st = () => [h.className, document.querySelector('.episode-title').textContent, [...document.querySelectorAll('.rail-beat')].map(b => b.classList.contains('is-on') ? 1 : 0).join(''), document.querySelector('.rail-pause').className, document.querySelector('.rail-pause').getAttribute('aria-label'), !!h.querySelector('canvas.hero-field'), document.querySelector('.hero-title').textContent].join(' | '); const out = [st()]; document.querySelectorAll('.rail-beat')[2].click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 3000)); out.push(st()); document.querySelector('.rail-pause').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); out.push(st()); document.querySelector('.watch').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); out.push(st()); [...document.querySelectorAll('.lang-opt')][1].click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); out.push(st(), document.documentElement.lang, document.querySelector('.lang-opt[aria-pressed=true]').textContent); return out;
